material_finding: Forge->Distillery replay idempotency is not yet causally stable. The current live-promotion regression proves byte-identical replay can be zero-delta, but PR #1687 identifies that evaluation-envelope volatility such as evaluated_at and candidate narration can change the full evaluation digest while leaving the measured execution unchanged, allowing the same evidence-bearing execution to mint a second packet/token increment unless replay identity is derived from stable execution evidence rather than the whole row.
steering: Do not grant Distillery dataset/training credit from byte-identical replay idempotency alone.
Retain one canonical Forge->Distillery admission path; do not create a second ingestion or truth authority.

Before promotion credit, execute PR #1687 or its nonduplicative fused successor on exact current source and require stable replay identity to exclude volatile timestamps and candidate narration while binding source, worker, target blobs, provider/model/role, execution admission and measured metric identity.
Require same stable execution identity plus mutated measured evidence to fail closed as REPLAY_IDENTITY_CONFLICT.
Require timestamp/narration-only mutation of the same measured execution to produce zero new packets and zero accepted_dataset_tokens delta, including after process restart/reopen.
Require a genuinely different execution identity to remain separately admissible.

After replay identity is executable-green, run the existing live funnel witness: one evidence-qualified ACCEPT -> exactly one persistent Distillery packet -> accepted_dataset_tokens > 0 -> semantic replay +0.

Keep the local Qwen3-0.6B nonterminal J-Space discriminator as the highest-information model-science gate, but do not execute unusual model interventions without the canonical atomic lease/coordination identity.
Do not grant HCU/J-Space/model/training/whole-product credit from source presence, model consensus, worker count, token volume or same-family repeated receipts.
Preserve FREE_ONLY: Together forbidden; PAID, SUBSCRIPTION and UNKNOWN fail closed; external free lanes require concrete credential+route cost provenance before execution credit.
